scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
ministry: DPIIT + Dept. of Financial Services, MoF
success_stories: 330+ loans worth ₹800+ Cr guaranteed as of Jan 2026
nlp_summary: Provides credit guarantee for startup loans up to ₹20 Cr. 85% guarantee for loans ≤₹10 Cr; 75% for loans >₹10 Cr. Startups apply through participating banks/NBFCs. Operated by NCGTC.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India
ministry: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
success_stories: For SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
nlp_summary: Bank loans ₹10L–₹1 Cr for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises. At least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch.

scheme_name: Term Loan for First-Time Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs (Budget 2025-26)
ministry: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
success_stories: Target: 5 lakh first-time entrepreneurs over 5 years
nlp_summary: Term loans up to ₹2 Cr for 5 lakh first-time women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting enterprises. Announced Budget 2025-26; operational details pending.

scheme_name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (Idea to Prototype)
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
sector_eligibility: Science/Technology-based physical products (excl. pure software/service/academic research)
success_stories: Access to PRAYAS Shala fabrication labs; dozens of centres across India
nlp_summary: Grant up to ₹10L for prototype development over 18 months. For individuals/early startups (≤7 years, revenue <₹25L) with science/tech physical product idea. Indian citizen ≥18 years. Implemented via DST NSTEDB.

scheme_name: NIDHI Seed Support Scheme (SSS)
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
success_stories: DST gives each incubator ₹1–2 Cr corpus to deploy as seed fund across multiple startups
nlp_summary: Seed funding up to ~₹25L per startup via DST-approved Technology Business Incubators. For post-prototype startups needing funds for product development and go-to-market. Applied through incubator's investment committee.

scheme_name: NIDHI-Accelerator
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
success_stories: Short-term cohort-based mentorship and business development
nlp_summary: Grant up to ₹40L per cohort to accelerator organisations to run cohort-based mentorship and business development programs for scaling startups. Startups get mentoring, industry connects and investor access.

scheme_name: ANRF Research, Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme/Fund
ministry: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Ministry of Science & Technology
funding_type: Concessional Finance / Equity-like instruments (via fund managers)
sector_eligibility: Deep tech; private-sector R&D and innovation (all sectors)
success_stories: ₹1 lakh crore outlay; Cabinet approved 2025; PM launched Nov 2025
nlp_summary: ₹1 lakh crore RDI fund to catalyse private-sector R&D and deep-tech commercialisation. Deployed via ANRF Special Purpose Fund through 2nd-level fund managers (AIFs, DFIs, NBFCs). Access is indirect via empanelled intermediaries.

scheme_name: New Fund of Funds for Startups (Union Budget 2025-26)
ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
sector_eligibility: Women entrepreneurship (25%); Climate & Sustainability (25%); All sectors
success_stories: Fresh ₹10,000 Cr tranche; 25% earmarked women entrepreneurship, 25% climate/sustainability
nlp_summary: Fresh ₹10,000 Cr Fund of Funds announced in Union Budget 2025-26. To be deployed via a fund manager through SEBI-registered AIFs. Implementation modalities pending notification.

scheme_name: Atal Incubation Centres (AIC)
ministry: NITI Aayog – Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
sector_eligibility: Healthcare; Agriculture; AI; Manufacturing; Transport; Water; All tech sectors
success_stories: 100+ AICs; 3,500+ startups supported; 1,000+ women-led; AIM mandate extended to March 2028
nlp_summary: AIM grants up to ₹10 Cr over 5 years to institutions to establish world-class incubators. Startups at AICs get mentorship, seed fund access, VC/angel networks, labs, and co-working space. 100+ AICs operational across India.

scheme_name: IndiaAI Mission – Startup Financing Pillar
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY)
sector_eligibility: AI; Deep Tech; Foundational model development
success_stories: 10,000+ GPUs planned; datasets platform; application and skilling initiatives
nlp_summary: National AI mission with 10,000+ GPU compute capacity (PPP), IndiaAI Startup Financing pillar, datasets platform, safe AI initiatives, and innovation centre. Access via notified IndiaAI platforms and partner calls.

scheme_name: MSME Incubation Scheme (Support for Entrepreneurial & Managerial Development through Incubators)
ministry: Ministry of MSME
sector_eligibility: All sectors with innovative ideas (MSME eligible)
success_stories: Up to ₹15L per idea + ₹1 Cr for incubator machinery + ₹1 Cr seed capital for graduates; 150+ approved incubators
nlp_summary: Up to ₹15L per innovative idea for prototype development via MSME-approved incubators. Additional ₹1 Cr to incubator for lab/machinery; ₹1 Cr seed capital fund for graduating startups. MSME contributes 15% (lower for SC/ST/women). 150+ host institutes.

scheme_name: SBIRI – Small Business Innovation Research Initiative
ministry: BIRAC, Dept. of Biotechnology (DBT)
category: Grant + Soft Loan / Mid-stage Biotech R&D
success_stories: Phase I (≤₹50L, up to 80% grant); Phase II (≤₹1 Cr+, 50% grant + 50% soft loan); Bharat Biotech early support
nlp_summary: Phase I up to ₹50L (up to 80% grant) for early-stage R&D; Phase II up to ₹1 Cr+ (50% grant + 50% soft loan at 2–3%) for later development. For registered Indian MSME/startup biotech companies. Two-tier evaluation: Technical Panel + Project Approval Committee.

scheme_name: BioNEST – Bio-Incubators Nurturing Entrepreneurship for Scaling Technologies
ministry: BIRAC, Dept. of Biotechnology (DBT)
funding_type: Grant to host institutions + Infrastructure/services to startups
sector_eligibility: Biotech; Life sciences; Agri-biotech; Marine biotech; Medical devices
success_stories: 74 centres; 8 lakh sq.ft. space; 1,000+ startups; ~800 biotech products developed
nlp_summary: BIRAC funds establishment of world-class bio-incubators (₹1–7 Cr grants to host institutions). Startups get wet lab space, shared equipment (sequencers, mass spectrometers), technical/business mentorship, and access to BIRAC funding schemes. 74 centres nationwide.

scheme_name: RKVY-RAFTAAR – Idea/Pre-Seed Stage Funding
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare
sector_eligibility: Agriculture; Horticulture; Fisheries; Dairy; Agro-processing; Farm mechanisation
success_stories: Up to 10–20 startups per incubator per cohort; 90% project cost covered
nlp_summary: Grant up to ₹5L per agri-startup to develop prototype/MVP over 6–12 months. 90% cost covered; entrepreneur contributes ~10%. Disbursed via 24 RKVY-RAFTAAR Agribusiness Incubators (R-ABIs) at agriculture universities/ICAR institutes.

scheme_name: Idea2PoC (Elevate 100) Grant
ministry: Government of Karnataka (Dept of Electronics, IT, Bt)
nlp_summary: Karnataka's flagship ELEVATE scheme offers up to ₹50 Lakhs equity-free grant to early-stage tech innovators registered in Karnataka to build and scale prototypes.

scheme_name: Karnataka Women Entrepreneur Innovation Fund (ELEVATE WomEN)
ministry: Government of Karnataka
nlp_summary: Dedicated funding of up to ₹50 Lakhs for women-led startups in Karnataka with at least 51% female ownership.

scheme_name: KSUM Idea Grant & Early Scaleup Fund
ministry: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)
nlp_summary: KSUM provides up to ₹15 Lakhs Idea Grants for R&D prototype development and commercial viability testing.

scheme_name: KSUM Soft Loan for Working Capital
ministry: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)
nlp_summary: Low-interest soft loans up to ₹30 Lakhs to meet initial work order and government tender execution obligations.

scheme_name: T-Fund Seed Capital Scheme
ministry: Information Technology, E&C Dept, Government of Telangana
nlp_summary: Telangana's T-Fund co-invests between ₹25 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore alongside recognized angel networks for Telangana registered startups.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Startup Week Work Order Grant
ministry: Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSInS)
nlp_summary: Top 24 startups receive pilot government work orders up to ₹15 Lakhs to implement solutions directly with Maharashtra Government departments.

scheme_name: Student Startup & Innovation Policy (SSIP 2.0)
ministry: Education Dept, Government of Gujarat
nlp_summary: Grants of ₹2.5 Lakhs for student POCs and up to ₹25 Lakhs via i-Hub for commercial prototyping and patent filing.

scheme_name: IN-SPACe Technology Adoption Fund (TAF)
ministry: Department of Space / IN-SPACe
success_stories: Co-funding % and caps differ by applicant category per notified TAF guidelines
nlp_summary: Cost-sharing support for startups/MSMEs/industry to adopt and commercialise validated space technologies. Co-funding percentage and caps vary by applicant category as per notified TAF guidelines.

scheme_name: iDEX – Innovations for Defence Excellence (DISC challenges)
ministry: Dept. of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence
sector_eligibility: Drones; Cybersecurity; AI; Robotics; Maritime systems; Mobility; Avionics; Defence tech
success_stories: 100+ problem statements; 200+ startups funded; unmanned supply drone; AI satellite imagery; Budget 2022 ₹300 Cr allocation
nlp_summary: iDEX issues defence challenge statements (drones, AI, cyber etc.); winning startups receive grants up to ₹1.5 Cr for prototype development over 12–18 months. Incubation at partner institutes; testing at military facilities; fast-track induction pathway via Make-II procurement.

scheme_name: IN-SPACe Seed Fund Scheme (SFS) – Space Startups
ministry: Department of Space / IN-SPACe
success_stories: Non-dilutive; up to ₹1 Cr per startup; milestone-linked disbursement
nlp_summary: Non-dilutive seed grants up to ₹1 Cr for space tech startups for prototype/MVP development and early commercialisation milestones. Applied through IN-SPACe competitive calls. Milestone-linked disbursement.

scheme_name: iStart Rajasthan Viability & Sustenance Grant
ministry: Dept of IT & Communication, Government of Rajasthan
nlp_summary: Offers sustenance allowances of ₹20,000/month, prototype grants up to ₹5 Lakhs, and viability grants up to ₹25 Lakhs for rated iStart startups.

scheme_name: Startup Odisha Monthly Allowance & Seed Capital Assistance
ministry: MSME Department, Government of Odisha
nlp_summary: Monthly allowance of ₹20,000/month for 1 year plus a one-time product development and marketing grant up to ₹16 Lakhs.

scheme_name: TANSEED (Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Fund)
ministry: Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission (StartupTN)
nlp_summary: TANSEED provides ₹15 Lakhs equity-free seed grant in 3 tranches to green and deep-tech startups based in Tamil Nadu.

scheme_name: IFSCA FinTech Incentive Scheme (GIFT City)
ministry: International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA)
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹1 Crore for regulatory sandbox testing, proof-of-concept, and global market expansion for FinTechs operating in GIFT City.

scheme_name: RBI Regulatory Sandbox Cohort Financing & Support
ministry: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
nlp_summary: Live testing of innovative financial products with relaxation in regulatory norms across designated thematic cohorts.

scheme_name: BIRAC SPARSH (Social Innovation Immersion Programme)
ministry: Dept of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹50 Lakhs for developing affordable biotech and healthcare innovations addressing pressing societal healthcare needs.

scheme_name: ICMR Innovation & Medical Device Commercialization Fund
ministry: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
nlp_summary: Comprehensive clinical validation and fast-track grants up to ₹1 Crore for indigenous biomedical devices and diagnostic kits.

scheme_name: NABARD Catalyst & Agri-SURE Fund
ministry: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
nlp_summary: A massive ₹750 Crore blended capital fund providing seed capital and scale-up equity up to ₹2.5 Crore for tech-driven agricultural ventures.

scheme_name: RKVY-RAFTAAR Agri-Business Incubation (R-ABI) Seed Grant
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
nlp_summary: Grants of ₹5 Lakhs (Pre-Seed/Idea) and up to ₹25 Lakhs (Seed Stage) for innovative startups in agriculture and allied domains.

scheme_name: PM E-DRIVE / FAME Advanced EV Startup Innovation Challenge
ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries
nlp_summary: Incentives and R&D grants up to ₹1.5 Crore for indigenous EV powertrain, fast charging, and cell manufacturing startups.

scheme_name: Waste to Wealth Mission – Swachhata Startup Challenge
ministry: Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to GoI
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹25 Lakhs to support startups converting plastic, electronic, and municipal solid waste into commercially viable products.

scheme_name: IndiaAI GPU Compute Subsidy & Innovation Challenge
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY)
nlp_summary: Part of the ₹10,372 Crore IndiaAI Mission offering subsidized access to 10,000+ GPUs and direct financial grants up to ₹1 Crore for foundational AI models.

scheme_name: AICTE-NEAT EdTech Acceleration Programme
ministry: Ministry of Education & AICTE
nlp_summary: Direct distribution to 50 Lakh+ higher education students across India through a national portal, with seed grants up to ₹50 Lakhs for top learning tech.

scheme_name: iDEX Prime (Defence Innovation Organisation)
ministry: Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence
nlp_summary: Flagship defense grant offering up to ₹10 Crore for solving strategic challenges for the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, and Coast Guard.

scheme_name: IN-SPACe Seed Fund & Orbital Launch Incentive
ministry: Department of Space (ISRO / IN-SPACe)
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹2 Crore and free access to ISRO testing facilities, launch pads, and ground station data for private space startups.

scheme_name: NITI Aayog WEP (Women Entrepreneurship Platform) Seed Grants
ministry: NITI Aayog
nlp_summary: Comprehensive platform providing seed capital up to ₹25 Lakhs, financial literacy, and corporate mentorship specifically for women founders.

scheme_name: Customised Credit Card for Micro Enterprises (ME-Card)
ministry: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
success_stories: Budget 2025-26 announcement; implementation details via DFS notifications
nlp_summary: Credit card with limit up to ₹5L for micro enterprises registered on Udyam. Announced Budget 2025-26 to ease working capital access.

scheme_name: NIDHI Entrepreneur-In-Residence (EIR)
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
success_stories: Primarily for graduating students/first-generation entrepreneurs
nlp_summary: Monthly fellowship ~₹20,000–₹30,000 for up to 12 months for aspiring entrepreneurs to pursue startup ideas full-time without taking employment. Applied at NIDHI-EIR incubator programme execution partners.

scheme_name: Technology Development Board (TDB) – Soft Loan/Equity
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
sector_eligibility: Clean energy; Defence tech; Healthcare; Biotech; Engineering (innovative indigenous tech)
success_stories: Funded 300+ projects since inception; supported India's first electric car launch
nlp_summary: Soft loans at 5% simple interest or equity for up to 50% of project cost (₹50L–₹10 Cr+) for commercialising innovative indigenous technologies. For near-market-ready companies. Repayable after moratorium from revenues.

scheme_name: BIRAC LEAP (Launching Entrepreneurs for Affordable Products)
ministry: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), DBT
nlp_summary: Provides scale-up capital of up to ₹1 Crore through BioNEST incubators to bridge the valley of death between prototype development and commercial scale.

scheme_name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)
ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
sector_eligibility: All sectors (excl. real estate, NBFC lending)
required_documents: Startup must approach VC daughter funds
success_stories: ₹11,808 Cr committed to 153 AIFs; ₹22,942 Cr invested in 1,270 startups as of Dec 2025
nlp_summary: Government fund-of-funds investing in SEBI-registered AIFs which invest in startups. FFS contributes up to 10% of an AIF corpus. Startups approach VC daughter funds, not FFS directly. Fresh ₹10,000 Cr tranche announced Budget 2025-26.

scheme_name: NIDHI Technology Business Incubators (TBI)
ministry: Dept. of Science & Technology (DST), Ministry of Science & Technology
success_stories: 150+ TBIs established; thousands of startups incubated
nlp_summary: Up to ₹10 Cr over 5 years to academic/R&D institutions to establish/operate TBIs providing workspace, labs, mentorship, networking and seed grants to startups.

scheme_name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
nlp_summary: Supports ICT startups through 51 MeitY-supported incubators. Offers Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR) grants of ₹4 Lakhs, Proof of Concept (PoC) grants up to ₹7 Lakhs, and Scale-up grants up to ₹40 Lakhs.

scheme_name: SAMRIDH (Startup Accelerator of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY)
sector_eligibility: IT/ICT; Healthtech; Edtech; Fintech; Agritech; Digital India sectors
success_stories: 22 accelerators onboarded; each startup can get up to ₹80L (₹40L Govt + ₹40L private match)
nlp_summary: MeitY provides up to ₹40L per startup matched 1:1 by private accelerator/investors (total ₹80L potential). For MVP-stage IT startups. Includes 3–6-month acceleration program with mentorship and market access via empanelled accelerators.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of MSME + SIDBI
success_stories: ₹9,000 Cr corpus infusion FY2023; 1.6 Cr guarantees issued; ₹8 lakh Cr credit supported
nlp_summary: Credit guarantee up to 85% for micro enterprise loans (≤₹5L) and 75–80% for loans up to ₹2 Cr. For MSEs without collateral. Entrepreneurs apply at CGTMSE-member banks; guarantee is bank-to-trust process. ₹2 Cr maximum guarantee cover.

scheme_name: SAMRIDH Accelerator Scheme (Product Innovation, Development & Growth)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
nlp_summary: Provides matching government investment up to ₹40 Lakhs to selected software product startups through empanelled accelerators and venture partners.

scheme_name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
ministry: Dept. of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, MoFAHD
funding_type: Interest Subvention (3% p.a.) + NABARD Credit Guarantee (25%)
sector_eligibility: Dairy processing; Meat processing; Animal feed; Breed improvement tech; Fodder
success_stories: ₹15,000 Cr total fund; 3% interest subvention; loan covers 90% project cost; 8-year tenure + 2-year moratorium
nlp_summary: Concessional financing for dairy, meat, feed infrastructure. 3% interest subvention; loan covers up to 90% project cost; repayable over 8 years with 2-year moratorium. NABARD credit guarantee for up to 25% of loan. Any private company/FPO/startup eligible.

scheme_name: Technology Development Fund (TDF) by DRDO
ministry: DRDO, Ministry of Defence
sector_eligibility: Electronics; Armaments; Avionics; Naval systems; Materials; Robotics; AI (defence use)
success_stories: 50+ projects awarded; radar components; optical sights; propellant development; Budget 2022 doubled allocation
nlp_summary: Up to 90% of project cost (max ₹10 Cr) as grant for Indian MSMEs/startups developing futuristic defence technologies. Company contributes minimum 10%. 2-year typical project duration. DRDO provides technical guidance and testing facility access.

scheme_name: Atal Community Innovation Centres (ACIC)
ministry: NITI Aayog – Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
sector_eligibility: Rural/local needs; Agriculture; Crafts; Rural healthcare; Social enterprise
geographic_restriction: Tier II/III cities; rural; aspirational districts
success_stories: 50 ACICs planned; examples: RGU Arunachal, IMERT Bhopal
nlp_summary: Up to ₹2.5 Cr grant to host organisations in underserved regions to establish community innovation labs. Focus on grassroots innovation relevant to local needs. Provides pre-incubation, tools, outreach and micro-grants to local innovators/startups.

scheme_name: Atal New India Challenge (ANIC) & ARISE
ministry: NITI Aayog – Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
sector_eligibility: Affordable healthcare; Housing; Food processing; Agriculture; Defence; Climate tech; Energy; AI (challenge-specific)
success_stories: ANIC 1.0 (2018): 30+ winners; ANIC 2.0 (2021); ANIC 3.0 (2023); robotic prosthetics; AI crop pest detection
nlp_summary: Innovation challenges across national priority domains. Winning startups/MSMEs receive grants up to ₹1 Cr to develop and deploy solutions. Includes mentorship from sector experts, govt pilot opportunities, and potential fast-track procurement. ARISE focuses on defence/space challenges with DRDO/ISRO.

scheme_name: RKVY-RAFTAAR – Seed Stage Funding
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare
sector_eligibility: Agriculture; Horticulture; Fisheries; Dairy; Food tech; Agro-processing
success_stories: 5–8 startups funded per incubator per batch; milestone-based tranches; connects to investors
nlp_summary: Grant up to ₹25L for DPIIT-recognised agri-startups with working prototype to commercialise/scale. Covers 85% of project cost; startup contributes 15%. Disbursed in tranches against milestones via R-ABI incubators.

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare
sector_eligibility: Warehousing; Cold storage; Grading/packaging; E-marketing platforms; Silos; Post-harvest infrastructure
success_stories: ₹15,000+ Cr loans sanctioned by 2023; eligible entities include startups, FPOs, co-operatives
nlp_summary: ₹1 lakh crore fund providing 3% interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 Cr for 7 years for farm-gate infrastructure. Loans also covered under CGTMSE (no collateral up to ₹2 Cr). Multiple projects per entity allowed.

scheme_name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of MSME (KVIC)
required_documents: VIII pass certificate (for projects >₹10L mfg / >₹5L service)
success_stories: 7.8 lakh units supported 2008–2023; ₹19,000 Cr subsidies; 64 lakh jobs created; 80,000 new units annually
nlp_summary: Capital subsidy 15–35% on bank loans for new micro enterprises. Max project ₹25L (manufacturing) / ₹10L (services). Beneficiary contributes 5–10%; bank loans rest. Mandatory 10-day EDP training before disbursement. Subsidy converted to grant after 2 years of successful operation.

scheme_name: BIPP – Biotechnology Industry Partnership Programme
ministry: BIRAC, Dept. of Biotechnology (DBT)
sector_eligibility: Vaccines; Biotherapeutics; Transgenic crops; Platform biotech; Stem cell; Medical devices (national priority areas)
success_stories: Supported rotavirus vaccine (Jaypee), multiple crop varieties; potential royalty/revenue share to BIRAC
nlp_summary: Public-private partnership for breakthrough biotech R&D. Up to 50% of project cost as grant; remainder as conditional loan/equity. Projects typically ₹2–6 Cr total. Multi-institutional collaborations encouraged. Three-stage evaluation: Expert Groups → Technical Screening → Investment Committee.

scheme_name: PMMSY – Fisheries Startup Grand Challenge
ministry: Dept. of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
sector_eligibility: Fisheries; Aquaculture; Cold chain; Aqua feed; Disease control; Fishing vessel tech
success_stories: Challenge 1.0: 12 winners, ₹2 Cr total; incubation at fishery incubators; Challenge 2.0 in 2025
nlp_summary: Innovation challenge by MoFAHD and Startup India for fisheries/aquaculture solutions. Winners (~10–12) receive ₹10L grants each plus incubation/mentorship support and potential pilot opportunities via NFDB.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
success_stories: Shishu (≤₹50K), Kishor (₹50K–₹5L), Tarun (₹5L–₹10L), Tarun Plus (₹10L–₹20L) categories
nlp_summary: Provides collateral-free micro-credit up to ₹20L to non-farm micro enterprises via Member Lending Institutions. Not exclusive to DPIIT startups. Covers manufacturing, trading and services.

scheme_name: TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY)
sector_eligibility: IoT; AI; Blockchain; Robotics for Healthcare; Education; Agriculture; Fintech; Infrastructure; Environment; Clean Energy
success_stories: 51 centres; emphasis on startups in smaller cities; ₹4–7L ideation/PoC grants
nlp_summary: Promotes tech entrepreneurship in 7 critical sectors via 51 incubators. Grants of ₹4–7L (ideation/PoC) and EIR stipend ₹7L to early-stage startups. Incubators receive MeitY grants for operations and equipment.

scheme_name: GENESIS (Gen-Next Support for Innovative Startups)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY)
sector_eligibility: Emerging tech (AI; ML; Semiconductor; Cybersecurity); Tier II/III city startups
geographic_restriction: Priority: Tier II/III cities Pan India
success_stories: Multi-tier: EIR ₹5–10L; Ideation ₹10L; Pilot ₹20–25L; Scale ₹50L; Deep Tech ₹1 Cr
nlp_summary: Umbrella MeitY program to democratise startup ecosystem beyond major cities. Multi-tier: EIR fellowships, prototype grants (~₹10L), pilot funding (~₹20–25L), scale-up up to ₹50L, deep tech up to ₹1 Cr. Focus on Tier II/III cities and underrepresented groups.

scheme_name: Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme – Semiconductor
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY) / Semicon India Programme
funding_type: Financial Incentive + EDA Tools/Design Infrastructure Access
success_stories: Implemented by C-DAC; includes access to EDA tools and IP
nlp_summary: Financial incentives and access to EDA tools, IP and design infrastructure for domestic semiconductor design startups/MSMEs. Implemented by C-DAC via the DLI portal under the Semicon India Programme.

scheme_name: ASPIRE – Promotion of Innovation in Rural Industries & Entrepreneurship
ministry: Ministry of MSME
sector_eligibility: Agro-processing; Farm mechanisation; Dairy; Poultry; Fisheries; Handicrafts; Rural tech
success_stories: 80 LBIs and 20 TBIs approved by 2020; seed capital up to ₹5L per startup via incubator
nlp_summary: Promotes rural entrepreneurship in agriculture/allied sectors via Livelihood Business Incubators (₹1 Cr grant) and Technology Business Incubators (₹1.5–2 Cr grant). Seed funding up to ₹5L per startup. Training and mentorship in enterprise creation.

scheme_name: BIG – Biotechnology Ignition Grant
ministry: BIRAC, Dept. of Biotechnology (DBT)
sector_eligibility: Life sciences; Biotech; Healthcare; Pharma; Agriculture biotech; Industrial biotech; Medical devices; Diagnostics
success_stories: 500+ projects funded since 2012; 10–15% success rate; 8 BIG Partner incubators (C-CAMP, IKP, FITT etc.)
nlp_summary: Non-dilutive grant up to ₹50L for 18-month proof-of-concept in any biotech/life sciences domain. For individuals (who must incorporate within timeline) or startups ≤5 years. Biannual calls (~50–60 awards per call). Disbursed via BIG Partner incubators.

scheme_name: MeitY Chips to Startup (C2S) Programme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
nlp_summary: Offers grants and free access to state-of-the-art EDA software tools (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens) and silicon tape-out subsidies for Indian semiconductor design startups.

scheme_name: STPI Next Generation Incubation Scheme (NGIS)
ministry: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), MeitY
nlp_summary: Focuses on startups originating in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities across 12 STPI centers with seed funding up to ₹25 Lakhs, ₹20,000/month founder stipend, and 3 years free plug-and-play incubation.

scheme_name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) Incubator Grant
ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
nlp_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹20 Lakhs for proof of concept/prototype development as grant, and up to ₹50 Lakhs for market entry/commercialization through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments via recognized incubators.

scheme_name: Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS) via SIDBI
ministry: DPIIT / Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
nlp_summary: ₹10,000 Crore corpus managed by SIDBI investing in SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) which in turn invest equity capital into promising Indian startups.

scheme_name: Scheme for Facilitating Startups Intellectual Property Protection (SIPP)
ministry: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks / DPIIT

scheme_name: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) Women Startup Programme
ministry: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)
nlp_summary: Up to ₹25 Lakhs equity-free grant and low-interest soft loan assistance to women entrepreneurs in Kerala who hold >51% equity.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Cyber Security Innovation Accelerator Grant
ministry: Maharashtra Cyber / MSInS, Government of Maharashtra
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹35 Lakhs for pilot deployment of anti-phishing, deepfake detection, forensic tools, and critical infrastructure protection with state police.

scheme_name: Telangana Mobility Valley (TMV) Seed Challenge
ministry: Emerging Technologies Wing, ITE&C Dept, Govt of Telangana
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹50 Lakhs and testing track access at Zaheerabad EV cluster for startups developing battery swapping, BMS, and autonomous mobility stacks.

scheme_name: Delhi Green Innovation & Air Quality Challenge
ministry: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC) / Environment Dept, GNCTD
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹25 Lakhs for deploying ambient air filters, anti-dust technologies, and bio-decomposer solutions for stubble and construction dust in Delhi NCR.

scheme_name: Startup Punjab Co-working Space & Internet Subsidy
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Punjab
nlp_summary: 100% reimbursement of lease rentals up to ₹25,000/month for 1 year in state-approved co-working facilities and high-speed broadband cost subsidies.

scheme_name: Bihar Food Processing Startup Capital Subsidy
ministry: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
nlp_summary: Up to 35% capital subsidy (max ₹50 Lakhs) for automated processing of makhana (foxnut), litchi, maize, and honey by Bihar startups.

scheme_name: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Startup Testing Fee Subsidy
ministry: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Ministry of Consumer Affairs
nlp_summary: Provides 80% concession on testing and certification fees across NABL-accredited BIS laboratories for DPIIT-recognized startups.

scheme_name: PGCIL (PowerGrid) Innovation Fund for Grid & Transmission Startups
ministry: Power Grid Corporation of India / Ministry of Power
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹2.5 Crore and live pilot testing on high-voltage transmission lines for startups working on transmission line drone inspection, fault prediction, and smart grid meters.

scheme_name: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) NAHEP Innovation Grant
ministry: ICAR, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / World Bank
nlp_summary: Financial support up to ₹20 Lakhs for student and faculty startups at State Agricultural Universities (SAUs) validating precision farming tools.

scheme_name: CDAC High Performance Computing & Quantum Cloud Access Grant
ministry: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), MeitY
nlp_summary: Free allocation of up to 100,000 GPU core-hours on PARAM supercomputers and Quantum Simulator (QSim) for training LLMs, molecular docking, and quantum algorithms.

scheme_name: Yukti National Innovation Repository (NIR) Commercialisation Grant
ministry: Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell (MIC)
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹10 Lakhs for university prototypes selected under the Yukti Innovation Challenge to establish registered commercial entities.

scheme_name: Tea Board of India TeaTech Innovation & Quality Grant
ministry: Tea Board of India, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
geographic_restriction: Assam, West Bengal, Kerala, Tamil Nadu
nlp_summary: Up to 30% capital subsidy (max ₹20 Lakhs) for digital tea leaf plucking mechanization, sensory AI quality testing, and direct-to-consumer export packaging.

scheme_name: Coffee Board of India Coffee Agritech & Roasting Modernization Subsidy
ministry: Coffee Board, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
geographic_restriction: Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh
nlp_summary: Up to 35% subsidy on eco-pulpers, automated roasting profiles, and IoT moisture sensors for specialty coffee startups.

scheme_name: Odisha Capital Grant for Women-led Tech Startups
ministry: MSME Department, Government of Odisha
nlp_summary: One-time capital grant up to ₹20 Lakhs for machinery and R&D for startups where women hold >51% of equity.

scheme_name: Gujarat i-Hub Incubation & Prototyping Assistance
ministry: Education Department, Government of Gujarat
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹10 Lakhs, free access to supercomputing infrastructure, fab labs, and dedicated venture mentorship at Gujarat Student Startup Hub (i-Hub).

scheme_name: Rajasthan iStart School & College Innovation Challenge
ministry: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Govt of Rajasthan
nlp_summary: Awards grants up to ₹5 Lakhs for high school and university student inventors in Rajasthan to convert school projects into viable startup prototypes.

scheme_name: Andhra Pradesh IT Infrastructure & Power Subsidy Scheme
ministry: Information Technology, Electronics & Communications Dept, Govt of AP
nlp_summary: 25% power tariff rebate for 3 years and 50% high-speed broadband subsidy for registered tech startups setting up development centers in AP.

scheme_name: Madhya Pradesh MSME Quality & Environment Management Subsidy
ministry: MSME Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
nlp_summary: 100% reimbursement of fees up to ₹3 Lakhs for acquiring ISO 9001, ISO 14001, CE marking, and BIS certifications.

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Marketing & Global Exhibition Reimbursement
ministry: IT & Electronics Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
nlp_summary: Up to ₹5 Lakhs reimbursement for participating in national and international trade fairs, startup expos, and global investor conventions.

scheme_name: Goa Startup Incubator Support & Operating Assistance Grant
ministry: Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa
nlp_summary: Grants up to ₹50 Lakhs for incubators and co-working spaces in Goa to subsidize incubation memberships and mentorship for local founders.

scheme_name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
sector_eligibility: Agriculture; Biotech; Social Impact; Waste Management; Technology-driven sectors
success_stories: 213 incubators approved; ₹467.75 Cr disbursed by end-2024
nlp_summary: Provides grants up to ₹20L for PoC/prototype and debt/convertible funding up to ₹50L for commercialisation via accredited incubators. Startup must be <2 years old, DPIIT-recognised, Indian promoters ≥51%.
